## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the ROS interfaces it affects.

## Validation

- [ ] Added or updated hardware-independent tests.
- [ ] Ran `colcon build --symlink-install`.
- [ ] Ran `colcon test` and `colcon test-result --verbose`.
- [ ] Updated interface, parameter, unit, frame, and safety documentation.
- [ ] Confirmed no generated files, controller addresses, credentials, or proprietary controller binaries are included.

## Real-robot impact

State whether the change can command motion, write controller state, execute a TP program, or alter connection ownership. Describe supervised testing separately from offline validation.
